Content retention is a lexical proxy, not semantic verification
No runtime candidate-contract evaluation in this experiment
Batch timings do not establish per-request latency or p95
Baseline retains previous transition definitions but uses the shared contrastive-test output format; not an exact repeat of the earlier eight-gap prompt
